Allow: /

# Block preview-mode endpoints from being indexed.
Disallow: /api/preview/

# Sitemap — generated by @astrojs/sitemap at build time.
Sitemap: https://teamrollouts.com/sitemap-index.xml

# RSS — Naver Search Advisor asks for a feed as well as a sitemap, and treats
# it as a content source (its guide wants the full article body, not an
# excerpt). No Google equivalent; listed here so Yeti can discover it without
# waiting on the Search Advisor submission.
# Naver's crawler is Yeti and is covered by the User-agent: * rule above.
Sitemap: https://teamrollouts.com/rss.xml
